scope.zh: 从机器人纠正经验到可复用的上下文适应；历史U3/A3审计保留
scope.en: Reusable in-context adaptation from robot correction experience; historical U3/A3 audits preserved

current.zh: 自身必做任务流中，复用旧反馈节省8.080次指令/六任务，完成率提高1.959个百分点。新增73,728条冻结策略分支，无新训练。任务/执行作用分离候选已查新并完成12,000次滑块物理检查；有效性未确认，新算法尚未建立。REVISE，机器人回合0。
current.en: Own required-task streams save8.080 commands per six goals and improve completion1.959pp. 73,728 additional frozen-policy branches, no new training. Task/execution separation audited;12,000 sliding-physics primitives completed, control validity unresolved. No established new algorithm. REVISE;0robot episodes.

title.zh: 先说明纠正传播需要什么新算法
title.en: Identify the necessary operation for correction scope

description.zh: 精确参考检查已完成，普通层级Bayes已给出传播与保留不确定性的行为；当前要明确与共享规则推断的操作差异和计算节省，再决定是否训练。E-RL²/DREAM、自主采集和物理任务仍是后续对照，尚未执行。
description.en: The exact reference check is complete; ordinary hierarchical Bayes already supports sharing and uncertainty. Identify an operation and cost difference from shared rule inference before new training. E-RL²/DREAM, autonomous collection and physical tasks remain later controls, not completed results.

status.zh: CPU符号环境可运行；具身/GPU未取得资格
status.en: CPU symbolic runtime ready; embodiment/GPU unqualified

label.zh: 相同历史的学得策略对照

status.zh: 15训练完成；主经验完成率门槛失败
status.en: 15 runs complete; primary support-completion gate failed

label.zh: 自主采集与新目标迁移

H11.zh: 来自相同任务、相同执行增益的历史。用于检验在任务与执行条件均匹配时，额外经验是否有用。初始记忆为共享 R₀ + H11。
H11.en: History from the same task and matching execution gain. Tests the utility of additional experience when both source conditions match. Initial memory is shared R₀ + H11.

H10.zh: 来自相同任务、不同执行增益的历史。与 H11 成对比较，估计任务匹配时的增益匹配效应。初始记忆为共享 R₀ + H10。
H10.en: History from the same task and a mismatched execution gain. Paired against H11 to estimate the gain-matching effect when the source task matches. Initial memory is shared R₀ + H10.

H01.zh: 来自不同任务、相同执行增益的历史。检验执行条件信息是否在来源任务改变后仍有作用。初始记忆为共享 R₀ + H01。
H01.en: History from a different task with a matching execution gain. Tests whether execution-condition information remains useful across source tasks. Initial memory is shared R₀ + H01.

H00.zh: 来自不同任务、不同执行增益的历史。与 H01 成对比较，检查异任务来源中的增益匹配效应。初始记忆为共享 R₀ + H00。
H00.en: History from a different task with a mismatched execution gain. Paired against H01 to assess gain matching for a different source task. Initial memory is shared R₀ + H00.

title.zh: 冻结与权限
title.en: Frozen parameters and permissions

text.zh: 神经参数、检索器与感知器参数在测试时冻结。增益 g 只对环境、scorer 和标记的 oracle 可见；模型只接收许可的 RGB、本体和 gain 前命令。
text.en: Neural, retrieval and perception parameters stay frozen at test time. Gain g is restricted to the environment, scorer and labeled oracle; the policy receives permitted RGB, proprioception and commands before gain.

title.zh: 共同标定与合法历史
title.en: Shared calibration and legal histories

text.zh: 两份名义 R₀ 先于变量 Hs 恢复。每份来源计划 64 步自由空间 + 64 步任务后缀；固定时序、真实边界图像和命令，不按 query 成绩选择历史。
text.en: Two nominal R₀ records precede variable Hs restoration. Each source plans 64 free-space steps and a 64-step task suffix, preserving chronology, actual boundary images and commands without selection by query outcomes.

title.zh: 配对统计与停止
title.en: Paired statistics and stopping

text.zh: 主比较按独立 query world 配对。任何必需来源不合法、提前终止或配额不足都会暂停阶段；保留失败与未知，不补抽幸存者。
text.en: Primary contrasts are paired by independent query world. An illegal, terminated or incomplete required source pauses the stage. Failures and unknown outcomes remain; no replacement sampling of survivors.

extra.zh: 命令—结果配对打乱，再冻结重编码
extra.en: Shuffle command–outcome pairs, then re-encode with frozen CTE

extra.zh: 同一 R₀ + Hs 的 RGB / 命令
extra.en: RGB and commands from the same R₀ + Hs

extra.zh: 真 query g 仅供补偿器
extra.en: True query g for the compensator only

title.zh: 构造V8：GL材质越界已定位
title.en: Constructor V8: GL material-range error localized

summary.zh: 单次CPU /tee=2 /0，首次mjr_render后GL1281。原始驱动指出glMaterial shininess越界；构造未返回，无RGB读回。
summary.en: One execution, CPU /tee=2 /0, with GL1281 after the first mjr_render. The driver identifies out-of-range glMaterial shininess; construction did not return and no RGB readback occurred.

metric_label.zh: 本次驱动错误 · 诊断计数
metric_label.en: Driver errors in this run; diagnostic count

observations.zh: 325项模型材料与569项场景几何中，各42项shininess越界；41项为−1023，1项为2。
observations.en: Among 325 model materials and 569 scene geoms, 42 in each have out-of-range shininess: 41 at −1023 and 1 at 2.

observations.zh: 渲染传入值乘128，得到−130944与256；与原始驱动41+1条错误一致。
observations.en: Rendering multiplies these values by 128, producing −130944 and 256, matching the 41+1 original driver messages.

observations.zh: 40个命名阶段39返回、1未知；4个原生C调用返回，但最后渲染包装失败。三组恢复成功，作者487/487与继续ACTUAL532/532复核闭合。
observations.en: Of 40 named stages, 39 returned and 1 is unknown. All 4 instrumented C calls returned, while the last render wrapper failed. Three attribute groups restored; author 487/487 and continued ACTUAL 532/532 checks closed.

observations.zh: 只读抽查3个资源XML，发现13项越界材质；尚未将这些文件逐一绑定到本次42项材料。
observations.en: Read-only inspection of 3 asset XML examples found 13 out-of-range materials. These files have not been bound to the 42 compiled materials in this run.

limits.zh: 定位范围仅限本次首次渲染；材料源头与修复的反事实验证未完成，不能证明旧137/139或历史图像损坏的原因。正式query仍为0。
limits.en: Localization applies only to this run’s first render. Asset provenance and a repair counterfactual remain open; older exit137/139 and historical image corruption are not explained. Formal queries remain0.

next.zh: 记录材料名称及所选XML来源，再审查独立的场景材质修复验证；原始失败保持冻结。
next.en: Capture material names and selected XML ancestry, then review a separate scene-material repair validation. Preserve the frozen original failure.

provenance.source_type: Actual native first-fault record; author487 and continued saved-record ACTUAL532; bounded XML examples

summary.en: The corrected version executed once, CPU / tee =137 /0. Only two pre-call checkpoints remain, with no terminal report or precise stalled-call location.

observations.en: Two checkpoints total1698bytes. Saved zero counts are pre-dispatch state; final constructor, native-call and control counts remain unknown.

limits.zh: 退出137不足以区分期限杀停、OOM或其他外部终止。日志没有崩溃栈，方法恢复状态未知。
limits.en: Exit137 cannot distinguish deadline killing, OOM or other external termination. No crash stack is saved; method restoration is unknown.

next.zh: 封存失败，不重复原版本。在新版本中补充更早的操作边界与定时栈记录。
next.en: Seal the failure without an unchanged retry. Add earlier boundaries and a timed stack record in a separate version.

title.zh: 构造 V5：执行前审查阻断
title.en: Constructor V5: blocked before execution

summary.zh: 初始化前错误查询已修正，但已返回原生上下文可能因后处理异常漏出显式所有权。该版本冻结，未执行。
summary.en: The pre-initialization query was corrected, but post-processing exceptions can lose explicit ownership of an already-returned native context. This frozen version did not execute.

observations.zh: CODE 核验 287 / 286，唯一阻断为返回上下文的所有权保留。
observations.en: CODE checks 287 / 286; the sole blocker is retention of returned-context ownership.

limits.zh: 尚无新构造结果；GL1281 对应调用和材质假设均未确认。
limits.en: No new constructor result. The GL1281-producing call and material hypothesis remain unconfirmed.

next.zh: 在独立新版本中保留已返回上下文，然后重新进行 CODE 审查。
next.en: Retain the already-returned context in a separate new version, then obtain CODE review.

summary.en: The pointer remains null after model creation and becomes nonnull after native render-context creation. The pre-initialization PyOpenGL query returned zero safely.

observations.zh: 一次原生执行 CPU / tee = 0 / 0；29 个检查点与终端记录完整。
observations.en: One native execution, CPU / tee = 0 / 0; all 29 checkpoints and the terminal record saved.

observations.zh: 保存记录作者核验 133 / 133；只读审查 230 / 230。
observations.en: Saved-record author checks 133 / 133; read-only review 230 / 230.

observations.zh: OSMesa 返回 Mesa 4.5 Compatibility Profile；三个安全错误查询均为零。
observations.en: OSMesa returned a Mesa 4.5 Compatibility Profile; all three safe error queries returned zero.

limits.zh: 只验证最小初始化机制，不证明旧段错误的实际崩溃位置、GL1281 来源或历史图像损坏原因。
limits.en: Establishes the minimal initialization mechanism only; it does not prove the historical crash location, GL1281 origin or cause of old image corruption.

summary.en: One execution ended with SIGSEGV 139, leaving two pre-call checkpoints. This version is closed.

observations.zh: 只读 ACTUAL 核验 246 / 246，失败记录保持封存。
observations.en: Read-only ACTUAL checks 246 / 246; the failure record remains sealed.

limits.zh: 最终构造、原生调用和控制计数以及方法恢复状态均为未知，不记作零。

next.zh: 保留旧版本；用独立最小探针检验初始化假设。

title.zh: 守卫在第一次像素读取前截获错误
title.en: Guard caught an error before the first pixel read

summary.zh: GC 最小检查通过，但首次 RoboCasa 构造检测到 GL1281；没有把初始化缓冲区当作 RGB 观测。
summary.en: The minimal GC checks passed, but the first RoboCasa constructor detected GL1281. Initialized buffers were not treated as RGB observations.

metric_label.zh: 首次失败 · 该版本零外部控制
metric_label.en: First fault; zero external controls in this version

observations.zh: 八个 CPU 回归检查已通过并保留；原生执行 CPU / tee = 2 / 0。
observations.en: Eight CPU regressions passed and were retained; native CPU / tee = 2 / 0.

observations.zh: 两个失败缓冲区保留原填充值 17 / 231，读取尚未发生。
observations.en: The two failed buffers retained fill values 17 / 231; their reads had not occurred.

observations.zh: 保存记录核验 112 / 112，只读 ACTUAL 217 / 217。
observations.en: Saved-record checks 112 / 112, read-only ACTUAL 217 / 217.

limits.zh: GL_INVALID_VALUE 的名称不足以识别错误来源。零外部控制不等于构造内部没有原生工作。
limits.en: The name GL_INVALID_VALUE does not identify its source. Zero external controls does not mean the constructor performed no native work.

next.zh: 保留首次故障；通过原生驱动回调定位具体调用。
next.en: Preserve the first fault and locate the responsible call using native driver callbacks.

title.en: Minimal render-context lifecycle controls

summary.en: Across three fixed branches, incorrect context selection caused readback failure; owner-selected controls kept images byte-exact.

observations.en: All 12 initialized readback arrays were checked. The failing branch retained GL1286 and buffer fill values.

observations.zh: 只读 ACTUAL 核验 481 / 481。
observations.en: Read-only ACTUAL checks 481 / 481.

limits.en: Establishes the release mechanism in this synthetic fixture, not the historical cause of RoboCasa image corruption.

next.zh: 在进程范围内保持资源所属上下文的释放规则。
next.en: Keep owner-selected release within the owned process.

title.zh: 运动可测，RGB 观测仍不合格
title.en: Motion is measurable; RGB remains unqualified

summary.en: Saved motion logs are auditable, but all 170 RGB frames exhibit severe degradation. They cannot establish the quality of the visual gain estimator.

observations.en: Saved data includes 65 end-effector/camera poses and 17 image boundaries; the cameras are not exactly stationary.

observations.zh: 完整记录只读 ACTUAL 核验 437 / 437。
observations.en: Complete-record read-only ACTUAL checks 437 / 437.

limits.en: Poor estimates under invalid observations do not establish method failure. Proprioceptive results with extra sensing do not replace matched-observation qualification.

next.en: Recover valid RGB collection, then test point identity, pose, amplitude and the local model's validity.

title.zh: 命令、状态与接触路径已记录

title.zh: 锁定问题与反事实设计

text.en: Nine complete candidates underwent novelty and research review. A bounded demo-cue × self-occlusion pilot was selected. Classical control matches gate cost in all 30 symbolic cases, ending scheduler novelty for this design. Visual, model and robot validation remain absent.
